resources.string: What is a VPN Tunnel Name?

This is the name of the WireGuard interface you want to automate.

To find it:
1. Open the WireGuard app.
2. Look at the name of your configured tunnel (often 'wg0' or similar).
3. Enter that exact name here so TriggerFlow can control it.

1. Enter your exact Home WiFi Name.
2. Enter the Tunnel Name from WireGuard App.
3. Enable "Allow remote control" in WireGuard App.
4. Grant Permissions and Save.
